spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Mischievous, malignant, ferocious, savage.
m. (-कः)
1 A beast of prey.
2 An enemy.
3 A Brahman, who has studied the Atharvan Veda.
E.
हिसि to injure, वुञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Injuring, hurting.
E.
हिसि to hurt, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-सा)
1 Injury, mischief, &c.; it is usually distinguished as of three sorts, mental, (as malice,) verbal, (abuse,) personal, (striking, wounding, beating, &c.)
2 Slaughter, killing, slaying.
E.
हिंसि to hurt or kill, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 Incantation to destroy, or the practice of magic, or employment of mystical texts for malevolent and injurious purposes.
2 Any mischievous or malevolent act.
E.
हिंसा injury, and कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Injurious.
E.
हिंसा, and आत्मक self.

m. (-रुः)
A tiger.
E.
हिंसा injury, ऋ to go or affect, aff. उण्.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Mischievous, hurtful.
E.
हिंसा injury, and आलुच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Mischievous, hurtful.
m. (-कः)
A mischievous or savage dog.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-रः)
1 A tiger.
2 A wretch, a villain.
E.
हिसि to hurt or kill, Uṇādi aff. ईरन् or ईरच्.

mfn. (-स्रः-स्रा-स्रं)
1 Mischievous, hurtful, injurious.
2

Murderous.
3

Formidable, terrible.
4 Fierce, savage.
m. (-स्रः)
1 BHĪ

MA.
2
Ś

IVA.
3

A beast of prey.
f. (-स्रा)
1 Spikenard (Valeriana Jaṭāmāṃsī.)
2 A shrub, (Abrus precatorious.)
3 A sort of grain, (Coix barbata.)
4 A vein, a nerve.
E.
हिसि to hurt, Uṇādi aff. रक्.

m. (-कः)
A beast of prey.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-शुः)
A beast of prey.
E.
हिंस्र mischievous, and पशु an animal.

m. (-लः)
The marshy date tree, (Phoenix or Elate paludosa.)
E.
हीन defective, i. e. small, ताल the palm, deriv. irr.

m. (-लः)
The marshy date tree: see हिन्ताल.

m. (-लः)
1 A swing.
2 One of the Rāgas or personified musical modes.
E.
हि particle, दुल to shake, घञ् aff., deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
A swing.
E.
हि particle, दुल to shake, aff. घञ्, and कन् added.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Deficient, defective.
2 Blamable, vile, bad.
3 Left, abandoned, quitted.
4 Wasted, worn, decayed.
5 Void of, free from.
m. (-नः)
An insufficient or objectionable witness.
E.
हा to quit, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Neglecting, or not performing the customary rites, &c.
E.
हीन, and कर्म्मन् act; also हीनक्रिय, &c.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Outcaste, vile, degraded.
E.
हीन abandoned, and जाति caste.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Of a low caste, outcaste, vile.
E.
हीन, and वर्ण caste.

m. (-दः)
Prevarication, contradictory evidence.
E.
हीन, and वाद speech.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
1 Dumb, speechless.
2 Inadmissible, (as a witness.)
3 Contradictory, prevaricating.
E.
हीन left, or defective, वाद speech, इनि aff.

n. (-ख्यं)
Keeping low company, associating with persons of degraded castes and occupations.
E.
हीन an outcaste, and सख्य friendship.

mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि)
Destitute of peace or reconciliation.
E.
हीन, and सन्धि alliance.

f. (-वा)
Serving or attending on low persons, associating with them.
E.
हीन, and सेवा service.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Crippled, maimed, defective.
f. (-ङ्गी)
An ant.
E.
हीन deficient, and अङ्ग the body.
